ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var sfId = payload.sfId default null var customerSfId = payload.customerSfId default null --- { query: "SELECT Id,FinancialAccountNumber,Type,Status,Name,TotalOutstandingAmount,SourceSystemIdentifier FROM FinancialAccount " ++ (if (sfId != null and sfId != "") "WHERE Id = '" ++ sfId ++ "' " else if (customerSfId != null and customerSfId != "") "WHERE Id in (select FinancialAccountId FROM FinancialAccountParty where AccountId= '" ++ customerSfId ++ "') " else "") ++ "LIMIT 200" }

%dw 2.0 output application/json var records = payload default [] --- records map ((account) -> { id: account.Id, globalId: account.SourceSystemIdentifier, externalIds: { system: "Salesforce", value: account.SourceSystemIdentifier }, accountNumber: account.FinancialAccountNumber, accountType: account.Type, accountName: account.Name, balance: account.TotalOutstandingAmount, status: account.Status })

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var sfId = payload.id default null --- { sfId: sfId, account: { (id: sfId) if (sfId != null), FinancialAccountNumber: payload.accountNumber, Type: payload.accountType, Name: payload.accountName default null, TotalOutstandingAmount: payload.balance default 0.00, Status: payload.status default "Active", SourceSystemIdentifier: payload.globalId default null } }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var id = payload.items[0].payload.id var account = vars.data.account --- { id: id default account.id default null, globalId: account.SourceSystemIdentifier, externalIds: [{ system: "Salesforce", value: account.SourceSystemIdentifier }], accountNumber: account.FinancialAccountNumber, accountType: account.Type, accountName: account.Name, balance: account.TotalOutstandingAmount, status: account.Status }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var sfId = payload.id default null --- { sfId: sfId, transaction: { (id: sfId) if (sfId != null), SourceSystemIdentifier: payload.globalId default null, TransactionCode: payload.externalIds[0].system default null, FinancialAccountId: payload.financialAccountId, Name: payload.transactionNumber, Amount: payload.amount, DebitCreditIndicator: payload.transactionType, TransactionDate: payload.transactionDate as DateTime, Status: payload.status default "Posted" } }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var id = payload.items[0].payload.id var transaction = vars.data.transaction --- { id: id default transaction.id default null, globalId: transaction.SourceSystemIdentifier, externalId: { system: transaction.TransactionCode, value: transaction.SourceSystemIdentifier }, financialAccountId: transaction.FinancialAccountId, transactionNumber: transaction.Name, amount: transaction.Amount, transactionDate: transaction.TransactionDate, DebitCreditIndicator: transaction.Type, status: transaction.Status }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var sfId = payload.id default null --- { sfId: sfId, card: { (id: sfId) if (sfId != null), FinancialAccountId: payload.financialAccountId, AccountId: payload.accountOwnerId, Name: payload.cardNumber, Type: payload.cardType, Status: payload.status default "Active", SourceSystemIdentifier: payload.globalId default null } }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var id = payload.items[0].payload.id var card = vars.data.card --- { id: id default card.id default null, globalId: card.SourceSystemIdentifier, externalIds: { system: "Salesforce", value: card.SourceSystemIdentifier }, financialAccountId: card.FinancialAccountId, accountOwnerId: card.AccountId, cardNumber: card.Name, cardType: card.Type, status: card.Status, creditLimit: 0 }
